pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING FOR UNDERSTANDING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.2 Reading for Fluency (2 lessons) • Word recognition • Comprehension B
Topic 2.3: Reading for Understanding

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading for Understanding. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can we enhance understanding while reading texts?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain key information in a reading comprehension
2. appreciate the role of reading comprehension in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: READING FOR UNDERSTANDING
Subject: MANDARIN · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Reading for Understanding helps you succeed in MANDARIN. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: READING FOR UNDERSTANDING
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Explain key information in a reading comprehension

What this means
In this part you learn to explain key information in a reading comprehension. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain key information in a reading comprehension.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Reading for Understanding”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain key information in a reading comprehension. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate the role of reading comprehension in communication

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the role of reading comprehension in communication. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the role of reading comprehension in communication.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Reading for Understanding to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the role of reading comprehension in communication. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Reading for Understanding is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Reading for Understanding”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: explain key information in a reading comprehension)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Reading for Understanding to a partner. (skill: appreciate the role of reading comprehension in communication)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Reading for Understanding to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain key information in a reading comprehension.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate the role of reading comprehension in communication.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Reading for Understanding from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Reading for Understanding: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Reading for Understanding?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we enhance understanding while reading texts?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Reading for Understanding means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain key information in a reading comprehension.
5. Be able to: appreciate the role of reading comprehension in communication.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
